Detailed Description

🏠 Server-side session hosting implementation

Implements the session host abstraction for server-side client management and session coordination.

  host, acip_transport_t * transport, acip_transport_ownership_t
  ownership, const char * ip, int port)


Register a transport-backed client. The same API accepts TCP,
    WebSocket, and WebRTC. Ownership transfers only on success. NULL registers a
    participant whose transport will be supplied later. on_client_join runs
    after admission.
